title: 第425章 刀心佛骨第424章 孤独的人心
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第425章：刀心佛骨
深夜的升邪竞技场，
褪去了白日的狂热嘶吼，
只剩地牢深处传来断断续续的呻吟。
佛不杀盘膝坐在囚室最深处，
周身法力被邪纹锁链封得严严实实，
破旧袈裟上还凝着半干的金血。
他脸色苍白，
眉心与心口两处隐隐作痛——那是金身也补不上的暗伤。
连日鏖战攒下来，
早已积重难返。
可他依旧捻着佛珠，眉眼间没有半分颓丧。
脚步声由远及近，
不重，
却带着生人勿近的煞气，
囚室铁门“咔哒”一声开了，
殷灭绝高大的身影堵在门口。
“都滚远点，没有我的命令，谁敢靠近半步，扒皮抽筋！”
守卫们噤若寒蝉，
顷刻间退得干干净净。

殷灭绝迈步走进囚室，
屈指一弹，
法力顺着经脉抚过受损心脉与大脑，将最严重的几处暗伤勉强稳住。
力道控制得极精准，
只续生机，
不愈全伤，
外人绝看不出破绽。
“死脑筋。”
殷灭绝收回手，语气里带着压不住的火气。
“我找到一条稳定的界域裂隙，
能绕开巡逻队直通玄黄边境，
我送你走。”
佛不杀缓缓睁开眼，眼底平静无波，只轻轻摇了摇头：
“殷施主，多谢好意，我不走。”
“第几次了？”殷灭绝气得笑了，“放着活路不走，非要留在这鬼地方等死，你佛宗修的是找死的法门？”
“贫僧不是等死，是渡人。”
“这竞技场地底囚牢里，还关着百万底层人族，他们大多是手无寸铁的普通人，老弱妇孺皆有，被圈养在这里，连牲畜都不如。”
“贫僧若独自逃了，
他们全都会死在擂台上。”
content_en:
Chapter 425: Sword Heart Buddha Bone
The Shengxie Arena in the middle of the night,
The feverish roar of the day has faded away,
Only intermittent moans came from the depths of the dungeon.
Buddha Busha sat cross-legged in the deepest part of the cell,
The magic power all over the body is tightly sealed by the evil pattern chains.
The old cassock was still covered with half-dried golden blood.
He looked pale,
There was a dull pain between the eyebrows and the center of the heart - these were hidden wounds that even a golden body could not repair.
Collected from days of fierce fighting,
It has long been accumulated and it is difficult to return.
But he was still twisting the beads, and there was no trace of depression in his eyebrows.
The sound of footsteps comes from far to near,
Not heavy,
But with the evil spirit of keeping strangers away,
The iron door of the cell opened with a click.
Yin Jue's tall figure blocked the door.
"Get away, everyone. Without my order, whoever dares to come even half a step closer will be scratched and cramped!"
The guards were silent,
He retreated cleanly in an instant.
Yin Jiedei stepped into the cell,
With a flick of the finger,
The magic power caressed the damaged heart and brain along the meridians, barely stabilizing the most serious hidden injuries.
The force is controlled extremely accurately,
Just keep alive,
All injuries will not heal,
Outsiders will never see the flaws.
"Dead brain."
Yin Jiedie retracted his hand, his tone filled with irrepressible anger.
"I found a stable rift in the realm,
Able to bypass patrols and go straight to the Xuanhuang border,
I'll send you away. "
Fo Bu Sha slowly opened his eyes, his eyes were calm and calm, and he only shook his head gently:
"Donor Yin, thank you for your kindness, I won't leave."
"How many times has it been?" Yin Miejie laughed angrily, "You have to stay in this hellish place to wait for death even if you don't want to live. Is your Buddhist sect practicing a method of seeking death?"
"The poor monk is not waiting to die, but to save people."
"There are millions of low-level human beings imprisoned in the underground prisons of this arena. Most of them are unarmed ordinary people, including old, weak, women and children. They are imprisoned here and are no better than livestock."
"If a poor monk escapes alone,
They will all die in the ring. "
